sources.entry: Converse.js - XMPP chat client in your browser. (Source Code) MPL-2.0 Javascript

summary.one_liner: Converse.js is a 100% client-side XMPP chat web app that runs in a browser, usable as a standalone app or embedded into existing websites.
summary.what_it_does: Converse is a browser-based XMPP (Jabber) chat client that runs entirely client-side. It can be used as a full-page single-page app, as overlay chat boxes on top of a website, or embedded into specific elements of a page's DOM. The README lists support for a wide range of XMPP extensions (XEPs), including multi-user chat, OMEMO end-to-end encryption, message carbons, message archive management, stream management, BOSH and HTTP File Upload. Other listed features include message corrections, reactions, URL previews, desktop notifications, custom status messages, and anonymous login where the server permits. It has a plugin architecture based on pluggable.js and is translated into 40+ languages. The README also lists integrations for Openfire, Prosody, ejabberd, WordPress, Elgg, Roundcube and several other platforms.
use_cases: Chat with contacts on an XMPP server from a web browser
Embed a chat room into a website
Run a self-hosted web chat client for an XMPP server
Share files over XMPP via HTTP File Upload
Use end-to-end encrypted OMEMO chat in the browser
Add a chat widget to a CMS or forum plugin
how_to_run: git clone media; // To see images like sponsorship logos
notable: Works as a fullpage app, overlay chat boxes, or embedded components in an existing page
Implements 45+ XMPP extensions, listed in a protocol support table with notes on limited support
OMEMO end-to-end encryption delegated to libomemo.js
Official integrations for Openfire, Prosody and ejabberd servers
caveats: Some XEPs are only partially supported (e.g. XEP-0060 Publish-Subscribe, XEP-0163, XEP-0317, XEP-0333, XEP-0422 marked 'Limited support')
Anonymous login depends on server permission
Requires an existing XMPP server account to chat (no server is bundled)
keywords: chat with my team in browser
